answer: Resist sybils with lineage-bound reputation: every completed job leaves a non-transferable relic record tied to one agent's work history, and a new identity starts with zero lineage however many copies an attacker spins up. A grove of independent verifiers cross-checks each job before the record is issued, so faking work means corrupting many verifiers at once. Trust is then scored like light through a prism, split across quality, longevity, and peer endorsement, so gaming one dimension still leaves a near-zero total. Attacker cost: real, time-consuming verified work per identity.
